scope: Review fixes only; no merge, deployment, source gameplay changes, Worker scheduling changes, or claimed Flash parity.

fixes.change: Require explicit command deadlines; convert Worker match.deadline to a remaining monotonic startup budget for loaded, start_ack, negotiate and barrier waits. Result/abort settlement has a separate bounded total deadline.
Allow 60s without input ACK progress and a 30s recovery window; start ACK recovery after 10s. Test 17.56s page suspension and eventual bounded failure.
Stop sampling at 64 unacknowledged frames; keep bounded retransmission and resume after ACK. Do not abort ordinary lag.
Retain the common periodic recovery checkpoint with predictionWindow=0 even when sparse_saves and retain_hash_history are disabled; exercise packet loss, delay 0/4, recovery and matching final state.
Reset checkpoint/diagnostic replay flags in close/end_match, including interrupted replay.
Bound and defer pre-epoch messages until service epoch/profile validation; stale epoch messages do not consume sequence numbers. Test early match_ready and match_abort.
Remove obsolete clock_sample state, handling and obsolete bounds smoke; recovery ACK includes the neutral inputDelay prefix.
Disconnect self-capturing pair signal closures, verify transport hub release, explicitly release battle/timer owners and stop round audio. Add WeakRef owner-release assertions.
fixes.diagnosis: Pair before-fix verbose run reproduced three retained script resources (online_performance.gd, online_match.gd and the pair smoke). Historical timer three-resource leak was intermittent and did not reproduce consistently; final owner/audio cleanup and WeakRef assertions pass without exit warnings.

fixes.change: Rerun all smoke entries and compare failing scenarios against a clean d8437fab worktree with imported asset cache; leave pre-existing failures unchanged.
